messages:
maria: Quick check — are we still on track to hand off KMS audit artifacts to compliance by Wed? I can push the evidence bundle to the shared S3 bucket.

devon: yes, working on the auditlog ingestion fix. ETA EOD Tue. I opened a PR with the ingestion validations.

sam: FYI the HSM team found a perf regression in the attestation script; PR is up: `github.com/redwood/crypto/attest/pull/123` — needs review, it changes the retry/backoff logic.

maria: @sam assigning to @jessica for review? Jess, can you take a quick glance, mainly the error handling and the edge-case when the HSM returns 503?

jessica: taking a look now, should be able to review by 4pm PT.

audit-bot: Reminder: control A.5.2 evidence due 2026-03-20. Please ensure artifacts are in the evidence bucket with correct tags.

devon: blocker note: the ingest pipeline is dropping some syslog lines when sequence numbers reset. Raised issue with eng-infra (#456). @leo can you confirm the backfill window and whether we can re-run without interfering with live traffic?

leo: I can run the backfill tomorrow morning; need the exact log ranges and a short freeze window. Dev, can you attach sample timestamps to the issue?

devon: added samples to the PR and linked the pipeline job logs (`deploy/pipeline-v2`). Also added a short runbook for retrying the consumer group.

maria: Ownership clarification: KMS key rotation playbook -> security (maria) for runbook content, ops (leo) for execution. I'll update Confluence: https://confluence/redwood/security/kms-rotation (private).

sam: small ask — can we delay the keystore canary rollout by one day to let the integration tests finish? This impacts Dedicated customers if the canary fails.

maria: OK to delay 1 day but we need an updated rollback plan and explicit GO/NO-GO criteria. @jessica can you add a short rollback checklist to the playbook?

jessica: added the rollback snippet and a binary checklist to the playbook page. Also included the healthcheck query and expected metrics thresholds.

devon: question for security-ops: when we hand evidence to auditors, do they want full raw logs or a sanitized subset? We need to know whether to run the redaction script.

maria: Auditors require full logs but with PII redacted per policy. We'll run the redaction pipeline before handoff and record the hash of the sanitized bundle. I'll coordinate with Legal for the attestation note.

leo: backfill started at 02:00 UTC, currently ~40% through. Progress logged in the pipeline job.

jessica: reviewed sam's PR, left one comment about exponential backoff jitter. Sam, please apply and then merge; I'll re-approve.

sam: fixed the backoff jitter and merged. Deploying to staging now (deploy/staging-keystore).

maria: Thanks all — I'll update the milestone tracker and ping the compliance lead after the backfill completes. Please react with :thumbsup: once you see the updated evidence bundle in the bucket.
